Iris (Docs): PR #9981 preview is failing: the alerting rule snippet in /console/observability/alerts.md throws `ValidationError: unknown field 'thresholds'` when rendering.
Ken (Eng-Obs): that's because we changed the alert DSL last week: `thresholds: [90]` -> `alert.threshold.value: 90` and `aggregation.by` replaced `group_by`. docs still have the old YAML.
Amir (Alerts): runtime enforces the new schema and the docs renderer validates snippets with the new schema too. We kept a server shim for a short window but the site lint catches the old format.
Iris (Docs): can someone push a small fix? it's blocking merges for a batch of docs PRs.
Zoe (SDK): opening micro PR to update YAML + examples across node/python/ruby. I'll include before/after and a one-liner for mass updates.
Ken (Eng-Obs): thanks. suggested migration snippet to include in docs: ```bash
# replace old thresholds/group_by keys in repo examples
sed -i "s/^\s*thresholds:/alert.threshold.value:/g" docs/**/*.yaml
sed -i "s/group_by:/aggregation.by:/g" docs/**/*.yaml
```
Zoe (SDK): PR 9983 opened. Example diff included: ```diff
- alert:
-   name: high-latency
-   thresholds: [90]
-   group_by: [service]
+ alert:
+   name: high-latency
+   threshold:
+     value: 90
+   aggregation:
+     by: [service]
```
Iris (Docs): please also add a short note in the alerts guide about the field rename and link to the SDK shim note. readers kept copying the old example verbatim.
Amir (Alerts): added a short compatibility note in the PR description: runtime will accept `thresholds` for two releases, but we prefer `alert.threshold.value`.
Rae (QA): once merged i'll run the alert render smoke: `curl -s -X POST https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/api/render -d '{"example":"alert-high-latency"}'` and attach the response.
ci-bot: PR 9981 preview: render-check failed (snippet schema validation)
Zoe (SDK): also updated the Node snippet showing programmatic rule creation: ```js
client.alerts.create({
  name: 'high-latency',
  alert: { threshold: { value: 90 } },
  aggregation: { by: ['service'] },
})
```
Iris (Docs): good. also found an internal link pointing to `/console/observability/alerts-old` — it's a legacy redirect and confuses preview search. can we remove it in the same PR?
Ken (Eng-Obs): removing redirect and adding a changelog bullet. won't affect runtime.
Rae (QA): smoke after merge: HTTP 200 and preview inspector shows `{"alert":{"threshold":{"value":90},"aggregation":{"by":["service"]}}}` and no validation errors.
Iris (Docs): merging after CI green. leaving a tiny follow-up to add a short migration snippet to the release notes and to the top of alerts.md. thanks all :white_check_mark:
